newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-CANTERBURY THUMPS QUEENSLAND 48-3.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CANTERBURY THUMPS QUEENSLAND 48-3.

text.p: The Canterbury Crusaders ended their Super 12 rugby campaign with a crushing 48-3 win over the Queensland Reds at Lancaster Park on Saturday.
The victory, which included six tries without reply, could leave the Crusaders fifth or sixth in the table depending on other results this weekend.
The Crusaders earned their convincing victory after wing Daryl Gibson and halfback Justin Marshall scored thrilling tries in the first half to set up a runaway in the final stages.
Marshall's try was a clever piece of work, weaving outside hooker Christiaan Knapp and cutting inside fullback Tim Horan to score.
Gibson set up his try from a counter-attack deep in his own territory. Flyhalf Andrew Mehrtens carried on and when he fell short, Gibson was on hand to dive over.
Centre Mark Mayerhofler, with two, flanker Scott Robertson and Mark Hammett rattled in tries in the second half to clinch the bonus points for the Crusaders.
Mayerhofler ended the game with a skilful individual try, after a weaving break followed by a kick and chase.
